```{r Import the differential protein analysis table of E.coli samples}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Import and save protein differential expression data
##============================================================================##
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

tar_folder <- "./Protein/DZLM2023051322-b1/result/4.Different_expression"
setwd(file.path(root_path, data_folder, tar_folder))

deps_list_origin <- list(
  "A5B5_vs_CHX" = read_xlsx("Differential_expression_matrix_unfiltered.xlsx", sheet = "CHX1-vs-AB5"),
  "PBS_vs_A5B5" = read_xlsx("Differential_expression_matrix_unfiltered.xlsx", sheet = "AB5-vs-PBS"),
  "PBS_vs_CHX"  = read_xlsx("Differential_expression_matrix_unfiltered.xlsx", sheet = "CHX1-vs-PBS"),
  "CHX_vs_A5B5" = data.frame()
)

# Reverse comparison direction and swap average columns
deps_list_origin[["CHX_vs_A5B5"]] <- deps_list_origin[["A5B5_vs_CHX"]] %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    log2FoldChange = -log2FoldChange,
    FoldChange = 1 / FoldChange,
    Regulation = case_when(
      Regulation == "Up" ~ "Down",
      Regulation == "Down" ~ "Up",
      TRUE ~ Regulation
    )
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Average_tmp__AB5", matches("^Average\\(AB5\\)$")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Average(AB5)", matches("^Average\\(CHX1\\)$")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Average(CHX1)", matches("^Average_tmp__AB5$")) %>%
  relocate(`Average(CHX1)`, .after = `Score Sequest HT: Sequest HT`) %>%
  relocate(`Average(AB5)`, .after = `Average(CHX1)`) %>%
  as.data.frame()

deps_list <- list(
  "CHX_vs_A5B5" = deps_list_origin$CHX_vs_A5B5 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "Gene Name",
      "Average(CHX1)", "Average(AB5)",
      "log2FoldChange", "FoldChange", "Regulation",
      "p-value", "q-value"
    ),
  "PBS_vs_A5B5" = deps_list_origin$PBS_vs_A5B5 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "Gene Name",
      "Average(PBS)", "Average(AB5)",
      "log2FoldChange", "FoldChange", "Regulation",
      "p-value", "q-value"
    ),
  "PBS_vs_CHX" = deps_list_origin$PBS_vs_CHX %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "Gene Name",
      "Average(PBS)", "Average(CHX1)",
      "log2FoldChange", "FoldChange", "Regulation",
      "p-value", "q-value"
    )
)

# Filter significant differential proteins
sig_deps_list <- imap(deps_list, ~ {
  x <- .x
  if (is.null(x) || nrow(x) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  x %>% dplyr::filter(`q-value` < 0.05)
})

# Intersect downregulated genes in both comparisons
genes_down_both <- intersect(
  sig_deps_list$CHX_vs_A5B5 %>%
    dplyr::filter(Regulation == "Down") %>%
    dplyr::pull("Gene Name"),
  sig_deps_list$PBS_vs_A5B5 %>%
    dplyr::filter(Regulation == "Down") %>%
    dplyr::pull("Gene Name")
)

genes_down_both <- sort(unique(genes_down_both))

fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.02.degs"))
saveRDS(deps_list_origin, "PBS_CHX_AB5.deps_list_origin.rds")
saveRDS(deps_list, "PBS_CHX_AB5.deps_list.rds")
saveRDS(genes_down_both, "shared_downregulated_genes_AB5_vs_PBS_CHX.rds")
```

```{r Enrichment analysis of differentially expressed E.coli proteins}
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.02.degs"))
genes_down_both <- readRDS("2Down_deps(AB5-Vs-PBS,CHX).Rds")

target_genes <- genes_down_both
#---- KEGG enrichment analysis
# ID tranformation
gene_entrez <- bitr(
  target_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.EcK12.eg.db
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)


gene_entrez_background <- bitr(
  degs_list$CHX_vs_A5B5$gene_symbol,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.EcK12.eg.db
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)


kegg_enrich <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
  organism = "eco",
  keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1
)

# set storage obj
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

kegg_enrich_df <- data.frame(kegg_enrich)
id2symbol <- setNames(gene_entrez$SYMBOL, gene_entrez$ENTREZID)

kegg_enrich_df <- kegg_enrich_df %>%
  mutate(
    geneID = as.character(geneID),
    GeneSymbol = map_chr(
      str_split(geneID, "/"),
      ~ {
        ids <- str_trim(.x)
        syms <- id2symbol[ids]
        
        paste(ifelse(is.na(syms), ids, syms), collapse = "/")
      }
    )
  )

out_dir <- "Protein.03.Enrich"
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
writexl::write_xlsx(kegg_enrich_df, path = "Unique_down_in_A5B5.xlsx")


##======================##
#program: use Gene SYMBOL -> GO enrichment（MF/BP/CC）
##======================##

library(tidyverse)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.EcK12.eg.db)
library(GO.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

#===== Part 1. SYMBOL
gene_symbol <- target_genes %>% as.character() %>% unique()
universe_symbol <- deps_list$CHX_vs_A5B5$`Gene Name` %>% as.character() %>% unique() 

#===== Part 2. SYMBOL -> GO 
go_all_sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.EcK12.eg.db,
  keys = universe_symbol,
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL","GO","ONTOLOGY")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GO), !is.na(ONTOLOGY)) %>%
  distinct()

TERM2NAME <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(go_all_sym$GO),
  keytype = "GOID",
  columns = c("GOID","TERM")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(term = GOID, name = TERM) %>%
  distinct()

TERM2GENE_MF <- go_all_sym %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "MF") %>% transmute(term = GO, gene = SYMBOL) %>% distinct()
TERM2GENE_BP <- go_all_sym %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "BP") %>% transmute(term = GO, gene = SYMBOL) %>% distinct()
TERM2GENE_CC <- go_all_sym %>% filter(ONTOLOGY == "CC") %>% transmute(term = GO, gene = SYMBOL) %>% distinct()

TERM2NAME_MF <- TERM2NAME %>% semi_join(TERM2GENE_MF %>% distinct(term), by = "term")
TERM2NAME_BP <- TERM2NAME %>% semi_join(TERM2GENE_BP %>% distinct(term), by = "term")
TERM2NAME_CC <- TERM2NAME %>% semi_join(TERM2GENE_CC %>% distinct(term), by = "term")

#===== Part 3. enrichment
ego_mf <- enricher(
  gene = gene_symbol,
  universe = universe_symbol,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_MF,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_MF,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 5,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

ego_bp <- enricher(
  gene = gene_symbol, 
  universe = universe_symbol,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_BP,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_BP,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 5,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

ego_cc <- enricher(
  gene = gene_symbol,
  universe = universe_symbol,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE_CC,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME_CC,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  qvalueCutoff = 1,
  minGSSize = 5,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

mf_res <- if (is.null(ego_mf)) tibble() else as_tibble(ego_mf@result)
bp_res <- if (is.null(ego_bp)) tibble() else as_tibble(ego_bp@result)
cc_res <- if (is.null(ego_cc)) tibble() else as_tibble(ego_cc@result)

mf_res
bp_res
cc_res

go_res <- bind_rows(
  mf_res %>% mutate(Cluster = "MF"),
  bp_res %>% mutate(Cluster = "BP"),
  cc_res %>% mutate(Cluster = "CC")
) %>%
  relocate(Cluster, .before = 1)
go_res


library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)

xlsx_out <- "GO_enrichment_results.xlsx"

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    MF = mf_res,
    BP = bp_res,
    CC = cc_res,
    GO_all = go_res
  ),
  path = xlsx_out
)
```

```{r Protein PCA Visualization}
) %>%

top_n <- 50

pc_contrib_multi <- purrr::map_dfr(pcs, function(pc_name) {
```

```{r Volcano plot of comparision groups}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Volcano plot of differential expression analysis
##============================================================================##
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.02.degs"))
deps_list <- readRDS(file = "PBS,CHX,AB5.deps_list(q_sig).Rds")

# set color
my_colors <- c(
  "PBS" =  "#8F5F9F",
  "CHX" =  "#E7B30B",
  "A5B5" = "#315E85"
)


# 准备用函数画图的代码块
fxx.plot_volcano_for_contrast <- function(list_obj = degs_list, contrast_name = "Healthy_Vs_Disease", 
                                          gene_symbol = "gene_symbol", log2FoldChange = "log2FoldChange"){
  df <- list_obj[[contrast_name]] %>%
    rename(
      gene = gene_symbol,
      log2FC = log2FoldChange,
      qvalue = `q-value`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(qvalue))
  
  q_thresh <- 0.05
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      significant = qvalue < q_thresh,
      regulation = case_when(
        significant & log2FC > 0 ~ "Up",
        significant & log2FC < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NotSig"
      ),
      color = case_when(
        regulation == "Up" ~ my_colors[sapply(strsplit(contrast_name, "_vs_"), `[`, 2)],   
        regulation == "Down" ~ my_colors[sapply(strsplit(contrast_name, "_vs_"), `[`, 1)], 
        regulation == "NotSig" ~ "grey80"
      )
    )
  
  
  n_up <- df %>% filter(regulation == "Up") %>% nrow()
  n_down <- df %>% filter(regulation == "Down") %>% nrow()
  n_total_sig <- df %>% filter(significant) %>% nrow()
  
  x_min <- min(df$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(df$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_vals <- -log10(df$qvalue)
  y_min <- min(y_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(y_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  round_down_05 <- function(x) floor(x * 2) / 2
  round_up_05 <- function(x) ceiling(x * 2) / 2
  
  x_lim <- c(round_down_05(x_min), round_up_05(x_max))
  y_lim <- c(round_down_05(y_min), round_up_05(y_max))
  
  main_title <- paste0("Experiment ", strsplit(contrast_name, "_vs_")[[1]][2],
                       ", Control ", strsplit(contrast_name, "_vs_")[[1]][1])
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = y_vals)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(q_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-Log10(p.adj)",
      title = main_title
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#000000", size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#000000", size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

                                                  gene_symbol = "gene_symbol", log2FoldChange = "log2FoldChange") {
```

```{r the pathway enrichment analysis and visualization of  Down-regulated proteins}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Pathway enrichment analysis, Visualization
##============================================================================##
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.03.Enrich"))
kegg_enrich_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Unique_down_in_A5B5.xlsx")

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.03.Enrich"))
go_kegg_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("GO_enrichment_results.xlsx", sheet = "GO_all")

sig_enrich_diff <- list(
  "kegg"  = kegg_enrich_df %>% dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05),
  "go"    = go_kegg_df %>% dplyr::filter(pvalue < 0.05)
)

dt <- sig_enrich_diff$kegg %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pvalue = pvalue,
    Description = Description,
    geneID = GeneSymbol,
    Cluster = subcategory) %>%
  dplyr::select(Pvalue, Description, geneID, Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pvalue) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))  

# dt: Pvalue, Description, Cluster
title <- "KEGG enrichment of Down-regualted Protein"
x_axis_title <- "-Log10Pvalue"
y_axis_title <- "Pathways"
color_palette <- c('#3C5488', '#8491B4')

p <- ggplot(dt) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = -log10(Pvalue), y = Description, fill = Cluster),
           width = 0.5, stat = 'identity', size = 0.2625) +  # 0.75pt = 0.2625mm
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.1, y = Description, label = Description),
            size = 2.1, hjust = 0) +                        # 6pt = 2.1mm
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.1, y = Description, label = geneID, color = Cluster),
            size = 2.1, fontface = 'italic', hjust = 0, vjust = 2.3) + # 6pt = 2.1mm
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) +
  labs(x = x_axis_title,
       y = y_axis_title,
       title = title) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'none',
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = 'bold', lineheight = 0.75), # 6pt
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),   # 6pt
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),    # 6pt
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.2625),  # 0.75pt = 0.2625mm
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

p
```

```{r GSVA  scoring of pathways}
##======================##
# Program: GSVA scoring with gmt_go (SYMBOL) and differential analysis between two groups
##======================##
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(org.EcK12.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GSEABase)
library(fgsea)
library(GSVA)
library(limma)

# Generate GO term to gene set mapping
selected_pathes <- list(
  "kegg" = read_xlsx("selected_pathway.xlsx", sheet = "Protein_kegg_path"),
  "go" = read_xlsx("selected_pathway.xlsx", sheet = "Protein_go_path")
)

out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-03.GSVA"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

go_df <- selected_pathes$go %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na(ID)

go2sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.EcK12.eg.db,
  keys = go_df$ID,
  keytype = "GO",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct(GO, SYMBOL) %>%
  inner_join(go_df, by = c("GO" = "ID")) %>%
  transmute(term_id = GO, term_name = Description, gene = as.character(SYMBOL))

gmt_go_list <- go2sym %>%
  group_by(term_name, term_id) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(sort(unique(gene))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(size = lengths(genes)) %>%
  filter(size >= 1) %>%
  transmute(pathway = term_name, genes)

gmt_go <- setNames(gmt_go_list$genes, gmt_go_list$pathway)
saveRDS(gmt_go, "selected_GO.gmt_list.symbol.Rds")

# GSVA: PBS vs A5B5
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.01.matirx+cli.format"))

expr_mat <- readRDS("matrix.Rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "PBS-1", "PBS-2", "PBS-3",
    "AB5-1", "AB5-2", "AB5-3"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("PBS", "A5B5"))

clinical_sub <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(samples %in% colnames(expr_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::select(samples, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(match(samples, colnames(expr_mat)))

expr_mat <- expr_mat[, clinical_sub$samples, drop = FALSE]

out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-03.GSVA"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

gsva_score <- GSVA::gsva(
  expr = expr_mat,
  gset.idx.list = gmt_go,
  method = "gsva",
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  min.sz = 1,
  max.sz = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

design <- model.matrix(~0 + group, data = clinical_sub)
colnames(design) <- gsub("^group", "", colnames(design))

fit <- lmFit(gsva_score, design) %>%
  contrasts.fit(makeContrasts(A5B5 - PBS, levels = design)) %>%
  eBayes()

gsva_diff_tbl <- topTable(fit, number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "pathway") %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val, desc(logFC))

saveRDS(gsva_score, "gsva_selected_GO_scores(PBS-vs-A5B5).Rds")
write_xlsx(gsva_score %>% as.data.frame(), "gsva_selected_GO(PBS-vs-A5B5).xlsx")
saveRDS(gsva_diff_tbl, "gsva_selected_GO_diff(PBS-vs-A5B5).Rds")
write_xlsx(gsva_diff_tbl, "gsva_selected_GO_diff(PBS-vs-A5B5).xlsx")

# GSVA: CHX vs A5B5
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.01.matirx+cli.format"))

expr_mat <- readRDS("matrix.Rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "CHX1-1", "CHX1-2", "CHX1-3",
    "AB5-1", "AB5-2", "AB5-3"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(group %in% c("CHX", "A5B5"))

clinical_sub <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(samples %in% colnames(expr_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::select(samples, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(match(samples, colnames(expr_mat)))

expr_mat <- expr_mat[, clinical_sub$samples, drop = FALSE]

out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-03.GSVA"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

gsva_score2 <- GSVA::gsva(
  expr = expr_mat,
  gset.idx.list = gmt_go,
  method = "gsva",
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  min.sz = 1,
  max.sz = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

design2 <- model.matrix(~0 + group, data = clinical_sub)
colnames(design2) <- gsub("^group", "", colnames(design2))

fit2 <- lmFit(gsva_score2, design2) %>%
  contrasts.fit(makeContrasts(A5B5 - CHX, levels = design2)) %>%
  eBayes()

gsva_diff_tbl2 <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P") %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "pathway") %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val, desc(logFC))

saveRDS(gsva_score2, "gsva_selected_GO_scores(CHX-vs-A5B5).Rds")
write_xlsx(gsva_score2 %>% as.data.frame(), "gsva_selected_GO(CHX-vs-A5B5).xlsx")
saveRDS(gsva_diff_tbl2, "gsva_selected_GO_diff(CHX-vs-A5B5).Rds")
```

```{r ssGSEA scoring of pathways}
##======================##
# Program: GSVA/ssGSEA scoring using GO-based gene sets (SYMBOL),
# followed by two-group differential tests and result export
##======================##

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(org.EcK12.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GSEABase)
library(fgsea)
library(GSVA)
library(limma)

#===== (1) Build GO gene sets: GO term -> SYMBOL =====#
out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-01.GSEA"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

selected_pathes <- list(
  "kegg" = read_xlsx("selected_pathway.xlsx", sheet = "Protein_kegg_path"),
  "go" = read_xlsx("selected_pathway.xlsx", sheet = "Protein_go_path")
)

out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-03.GSVA(2test)"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

go_df <- selected_pathes$go %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na(ID)

go2sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.EcK12.eg.db,
  keys = go_df$ID,
  keytype = "GO",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct(GO, SYMBOL) %>%
  inner_join(go_df, by = c("GO" = "ID")) %>%
  transmute(term_id = GO, term_name = Description, gene = as.character(SYMBOL))

gmt_go_list <- go2sym %>%
  group_by(term_name, term_id) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(sort(unique(gene))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(size = lengths(genes)) %>%
  filter(size >= 1) %>%
  transmute(pathway = term_name, genes)

gmt_go <- setNames(gmt_go_list$genes, gmt_go_list$pathway)
saveRDS(gmt_go, "selected_GO.gmt_list.symbol.Rds")

#===== (2) Load expression matrix and clinical data =====#
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "Protein.01.matirx+cli.format"))

expr_mat <- readRDS("matrix.Rds") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "PBS-1", "PBS-2", "PBS-3",
    "CHX1-1", "CHX1-2", "CHX1-3",
    "AB5-1", "AB5-2", "AB5-3"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds")

clinical_sub <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(samples %in% colnames(expr_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::select(samples, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(match(samples, colnames(expr_mat)))

expr_mat <- expr_mat[, clinical_sub$samples, drop = FALSE]

#===== (3) GSVA scoring =====#
out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-03.GSVA(2test)"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

gsva_score <- GSVA::gsva(
  expr = expr_mat,
  gset.idx.list = gmt_go,
  method = "gsva",
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  min.sz = 1,
  max.sz = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

df <- gsva_score %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("path")

res <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(-path, names_to = "sample", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "^PBS") ~ "PBS",
    str_detect(sample, "^CHX") ~ "CHX",
    str_detect(sample, "^AB5") ~ "AB5",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  group_by(path) %>%
  summarise(
    p_pbs_ab5 = t.test(value[group == "PBS"], value[group == "AB5"])$p.value,
    p_chx_ab5 = t.test(value[group == "CHX"], value[group == "AB5"])$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_pbs_ab5 = p.adjust(p_pbs_ab5, method = "BH"),
    padj_chx_ab5 = p.adjust(p_chx_ab5, method = "BH")
  )

sig_rows <- res %>%
  filter(padj_pbs_ab5 < 0.05, padj_chx_ab5 < 0.05)

saveRDS(gsva_score, "gsva_selected_GO_scores(3Group).Rds")
write_xlsx(
  gsva_score %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("path"),
  "gsva_selected_GO(3Group).xlsx"
)
write_xlsx(res, "gsva_selected_GO_ttest_results.xlsx")
write_xlsx(sig_rows, "gsva_selected_GO_ttest_significant.xlsx")

#===== (4) ssGSEA scoring =====#
out_dir <- "Protein.05.EnrichPath-02.ssGSEA2test)"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

ssgsea_score <- GSVA::gsva(
  expr = expr_mat,
  gset.idx.list = gmt_go,
  method = "ssgsea",
  kcdf = "Gaussian",
  min.sz = 1,
  max.sz = 5000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

df <- ssgsea_score %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("path")

res <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(-path, names_to = "sample", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "^PBS") ~ "PBS",
    str_detect(sample, "^CHX") ~ "CHX",
    str_detect(sample, "^AB5") ~ "AB5",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  group_by(path) %>%
  summarise(
    p_pbs_ab5 = t.test(value[group == "PBS"], value[group == "AB5"])$p.value,
    p_chx_ab5 = t.test(value[group == "CHX"], value[group == "AB5"])$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_pbs_ab5 = p.adjust(p_pbs_ab5, method = "BH"),
    padj_chx_ab5 = p.adjust(p_chx_ab5, method = "BH")
  )

sig_rows <- res %>%
  filter(padj_pbs_ab5 < 0.05, padj_chx_ab5 < 0.05)

saveRDS(ssgsea_score, "ssgsea_selected_GO_scores(3Group).Rds")
write_xlsx(
  ssgsea_score %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("path"),
  "ssgsea_selected_GO(3Group).xlsx"
)
write_xlsx(res, "ssgsea_selected_GO_ttest_results.xlsx")
write_xlsx(sig_rows, "ssgsea_selected_GO_ttest_significant.xlsx")
```
